newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-RESULTS OF WORLD TITLE FIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-RESULTS OF WORLD TITLE FIGHTS.

text.p: Ronald Wright of the United States retained his World Boxing Organisation (WBO) light-middleweight title on Saturday when he stopped Britain's Steve Foster in the sixth of 12 scheduled rounds).

Britain's "Prince" Naseem Hamed retained his unified World Boxing Organisation (WBO) and International Boxing Federation (IBF) featherweight titles when he stopped compatriot Billy Hardy in the first of 12 scheduled rounds.
Britain's Robin Reid retained his World Boxing Council (WBC) super-middleweight title when he outpointed compatriot Henry Wharton after the scheduled 12 rounds.
One of the judges scored the fight even at 114 points each. The other two scored in Reid's favour 117-113 and 118-111.
